summary: The candidate is a partial fix. It reproduces and fixes the three explicit fp32-router-output downcasts, adds a shared RouterGate entry point, and passes its focused regression. It does not fulfill the original full-consolidation contract: the enabled ROCm/AITER backend stores the GEMM result as bf16 before converting it to fp32, five named model families retain model-local routing implementations, and the nominally neutral GEMM module only re-exports the implementation from the DSv4 attention namespace.

tests.what_was_measured: Actual BailingMoE, BailingMoELinear, and LLaDA2 gate implementations on MI350X returned bf16 and differed from an independent fp32 reference by up to 0.0308475494, reproducing the original silent-downcast defect.
The same actual gate implementations returned fp32 and exactly matched the independent fp32 reference, confirming that narrow correction.
Candidate regression suite: three tests passed, covering CPU fp32 reference/output dtype, fp32 parameters and correction bias, and mocked deterministic bypass.

Real MI350X AITER path at M=1,8,16,17,64. Every fp32-typed result was bit-identical to the fp32 reference rounded through bf16, with max absolute errors 0.0686-0.1217, proving the backend stores bf16 before upcasting.
Real MI350X fallback path at M=1,8,16,17,64 returned fp32 results that were not bf16-rounded; max absolute error versus the independent fp32 matmul was at most 3.8147e-06.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X, PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 / HIP 7.2.26015. Both AITER-enabled and fallback numerical paths were exercised.

remaining_counterexamples: With SGLANG_USE_AITER=1, linear_bf16_fp32 calls tgemm.mm(..., otype=x.dtype).float(); for bf16 input the measured output equals an independently computed fp32 result rounded to bf16 and back, violating the required fp32 output-store contract.
Hunyuan-v3 still explicitly upcasts hidden states to fp32 in its model-local ReplicatedLinear router path.
MiniMax-M3 still retains model-local routing and an fp32 activation-upcast fallback.
Sarvam-MoE still retains model-local F.linear/ReplicatedLinear router paths.
Step3.5 still retains model-local routing and an explicit fp32 matmul branch.
Nemotron-H still retains model-local torch.mm routing rather than the proposed shared RouterGate policy.
python/sglang/kernels/ops/gemm/bf16_fp32.py is a compatibility re-export; the implementation and policy remain physically under kernels/ops/attention/dsv4/gemm.py.
remaining_limitations: CUDA-only tiny GEMM, DeepGEMM, and HPC-Ops could not be qualified on the assigned AMD GPU.
AMX, NPU, XPU, distributed execution, checkpoint loading, full-model semantic accuracy, and serving benchmarks were not run.
No native C++ files changed and repository-environment.json provides no native build target, so no native rebuild was applicable.
The prepared checkout exactly matched the recorded base commit; there was no base discrepancy.
